<!-- pr-reviewer: cf336a22511a789bdcc84fc5d6299a575655fae8 -->
Needs changes before merge. SAFETY-tier review: two blockers.

The trial merge with upstream main `17b1b2b81c2fc555fdaa3f06dec73000d19d20c7` succeeded. All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

The default refusal for legacy records is correct. The new flag survives the project and stream round trips. I checked all three changed NC goldens line by line. Only the initial Z words change: 14 to 16, 14.625 to 16.625, and 0.5512 to 0.6299. The revised fixtures explain these changes.

Requested before merge:

1. **[P1] Prove clearance between stock samples.** `crates/app/src/operation/g76_start.rs:149` checks isolated stations. It does not include the stock profile breakpoints or prove clearance between stations. A narrow stock rib can fall between samples. The function then sets `start_in_air = true` with material inside the rapid-infeed band.

   I reproduced this with the existing relief-groove unit test. Keep its wide-groove part and the 1.732 mm insert. Use stock with the same groove, but leave a radius-6 rib from Z13.16 to Z13.20. The rest of the groove floor stays at radius 4.5. The insert band is [13.134, 14.866]. Adjacent samples are approximately Z13.134 and Z13.2302, so neither sample meets the rib. With no prior cuts, the existing assertion fails:

   ```text
   panicked at crates/app/src/operation/g76_start.rs:289:9:
   uncut stock in relief groove must refuse
   ```

   Use a conservative interval check for remaining stock and prior-cut coverage. Include profile breakpoints. Refuse the cycle when clearance cannot be proved. Add a regression for material between samples. The radial sampling also needs a conservative clearance rule.

2. **[P2] Supply the required heavy-lane results.** The PR body's Tests section lists the quick gate and clippy only. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “Heavy lanes at review”, requires the reached lanes and their results in the body. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches the motion and app heavy lanes. Run these lanes on the corrected final head and record their results. Heavy tests were not run in this review. Their status is not a pass.

Local validation:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with upstream main | Clean |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 962 steps, 0 failed; 39.1 minutes; batch fallback because CL changed |
| Gate clippy, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |
| Restored `turning_thread_cycle` suite | 4 passed |
| Restored `operation::g76_start::tests` | 2 passed |
| Heavy lanes | Plan checked; tests not run |

Extra suites run:

The changed goldens and their fixture readers were checked again after the baseline gate.

| App suite | Passed |
|---|---:|
| `conformance` | 7 |
| `lathe_post` | 7 |
| `lathe_post_g76` | 8 |
| `lathe_post_g76_schedule` | 7 |
| `lathe_post_g76_start` | 5 |
| `lathe_post_inch` | 6 |
| `program_units` | 7 |
| `solid_law_goldens` | 7 |

No importer code or STEP fixture changed. The extra importer rule does not apply.

Mutations rerun:

- Removed the post's `StartInAir` guard: 4 of 5 start tests failed. Restored the guard: all 5 passed.
- Forced the motion record's `start_in_air` flag to true: the solid-bar test failed. Restored the calculation: all 4 cycle tests passed.

The narrow-stock fixture check failed as described above. The original fixture was restored, and both original unit tests passed. All temporary changes were removed. No screenshot, log, or review evidence was committed or pushed.

No physical control or external Fanuc simulator was exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
